name: Make every shot count, ya landlubber!
author: SpaceCat8000
description: My take on the CountingPrototype. Features: The ship will sail back and forth as you pelt it with cannon balls; The cannon rotates around the y axis, the barrel rotates around the x axis; zoom in the camera with right-click; sound effects will play when you hit the ship; and, most importantly, the counter in the bottom left updates each time you hit the ship.
